title: WGPU Clip Conformance Harness Follow-on v1
problem: The shared WGPU test readback/render harness landed for the path conformance batch, but the clip-related conformance tests still carry local copies of the same harness helpers. This keeps the renderer test surface noisier than necessary and risks readback-helper drift in clip gates.

repro.summary: Clip-related WGPU conformance tests should render and sample through the shared integration-test support module while preserving existing pixel assertions.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test clip_path_conformance --test affine_clip_conformance -j 1

gates.name: clip-conformance-batch
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test clip_path_conformance --test affine_clip_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The named clip tests migrated successfully. Future effect/text/readback families should start narrower follow-ons instead of widening this one.
